facts.fact: 到访的 truth-taster Evert Zuermont 在 Sieuxerr 观看了一名因杀害妻子——一位 healer——而被定罪的男子的公开处决后，写信给他的赞助人 Katte 太后

facts.fact: Estiene 的祖母坚持与 Marion 换座位，把继母 Oudine 所生的 Marion 打发到长桌另一头 Lord Tixerrant 身边
facts.anchor: Estiene’s grandmother insisted on switching seats with Marion

facts.fact: Marion 十三岁，生着 Marcelle 家的黑发和母亲的圆鼻头
facts.anchor: Marion had the Marcelle black hair, and her mother’s round-tipped nose, and at thirteen

facts.fact: Estiene 第一次见到 Jehan Fortier 时，对方是个十八岁、笑声刺耳、衣着凌乱的一年级学者，正与同届 cohort 庆祝成为学者的第一夜，并把一杯朗姆酒推给 Estiene
facts.anchor: seeing only a skinny eighteen-year-old with a piercing laugh and untidy clothes

facts.fact: Estiene 认定这段折腾了五年的感情已经结束，但他还必须撑过 Grand Exam 余下的四天
facts.anchor: hold it together through four more days of the Grand Exam

facts.fact: Estiene 上周偷听到父亲 Head Healer Marcelle 与校长 Chancellor Morant 的谈话：父亲明确表示儿子不许在 Grand Exam 中失败，且要以足够高的毕业分数稳拿 junior diagnostics-track 职位，校长同意了
facts.anchor: his son would not be allowed to fail the Grand Exam

facts.fact: Lord Calonne 在餐桌上说一名五年级学者当天早上被发现死亡、没能参加 Grand Exam，并猜她是 burnout
facts.anchor: being found dead this morning, before she could sit the Grand Exam

facts.fact: Estiene 的父亲称死者 Scholar Caudotte 是行业的真正损失，并说不是随便谁都能在 Dux Scolaris 上压过 Estiene——意指她本会赢
facts.anchor: Not just anyone would have been beating out Estiene for Dux Scolaris
